exact: disruption by symbiont of host chloroplast thylakoid
related: modification by symbiont of host chloroplast thylakoid

definition: The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host cell chloroplast thylakoid. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated disruption of host chloroplast thylakoid
